newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu defends wife, children against media.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu defends wife, children against media.

text.p: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Tuesday Israeli media treatment of his wife and children was "vicious, ugly" and he wanted it to stop.
"I do not understand why they attack my wife and my children," Netanyahu, 47, told Israel's Channel One television when asked his opinion of Israeli media treatment of his family.
"I think this is a vicious, ugly phenomenon. I suggest they stop it. Deal with me, that's enough."

Sara Netanyahu, 37, was propelled into the media spotlight soon after her husband took office when a nanny she sacked over burnt soup accused the first lady of being a harsh taskmaster with a sharp temper.

In October, Sara was back in the tabloids when her first husband threatened to publish a book about their six-year marriage. He later backed down. Later in the month her brother, a Jewish settler, embarrassed Netanyahu by quitting his right- wing Likud party, publicly declaring his brother-in-law had betrayed what he believed was Israel's right to the West Bank.

Mrs Netanyahu, though frequently at the prime minister's side, has been a silent partner -- letting her husband do all the talking. She is the third wife of the twice-divorced Netanyahu, who in 1993 admitted cheating on her. They have two sons, aged four and one.
